defense.shortComment: McCollum (illness) did not participate at practice Wednesday.

defense.name: Antoine Winfield Jr.
defense.shortComment: Winfield (ribs) was a limited participant at practice Wednesday.

offense.name: Calvin Ridley
offense.shortComment: Ridley (hip) was a limited participant in practice Wednesday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site  reports.

defense.name: Tony Adams
defense.shortComment: Adams (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Colts.

defense.name: Kevin Winston Jr.
defense.shortComment: Winston (quadriceps) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

injuredReserveOrOut.name: Dorian Mausi
injuredReserveOrOut.shortComment: Mausi (undisclosed) had his 21-day practice window opened by the Titans on Wednesday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official website reports.

offense.name: Jaylin Lane
offense.shortComment: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

offense.name: Marcus Mariota
offense.shortComment: doubtful

offense.name: Terry McLaurin
offense.shortComment: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn announced Monday that McLaurin has been diagnosed with a torn patellar tendon in his left knee following an MRI and will miss the rest of the season.

defense.name: Javontae Jean-Baptiste

defense.name: Javon Kinlaw
